title: Mike Kelley

publisher.name: Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam / DelMonico Books, Prestel

description.main: Catalogue of the Stedelijk Museum's 2012-13 Mike Kelley retrospective, edited by Eva Meyer-Hermann and Lisa Gabrielle Mark.
description.extended:
The catalogue of the Stedelijk Museum's Mike Kelley retrospective of 2012-13, the first comprehensive survey of the artist since 1993.

Eva Meyer-Hermann and Lisa Gabrielle Mark edited the 400-page book with Ann Goldstein, and Lorraine Wild designed it. It carries essays by John C. Welchman, Branden W. Joseph and George Baker, and Meyer-Hermann's interview with Kelley, the last he gave. A plate section with work descriptions by Welchman is followed by an updated exhibition history, bibliography, videography and list of performances.

The exhibition ran at the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam from 15 December 2012 to 1 April 2013 and showed more than 200 works from 35 years. Goldstein, then the museum's director, organised it with the Mike Kelley Foundation for the Arts. It travelled to the Centre Pompidou in Paris, MoMA PS1 in New York and the Museum of Contemporary Art in Los Angeles. Kelley died in 2012.
